name: SigNoz
summary: SigNoz is open source and also sold as a cloud service. Cloud usage costs $0.30 per GB of traces and $0.10 per million metric samples, and the Teams plan starts at $49 a month with $49 of usage included. Enterprise starts at $4,000 a month.

facts.text: For each service the APM view lists p99, p90 and p50 latency, request rate, error rate and an Apdex score.
Alerts can fire on span conditions such as high p99 latency or elevated error counts, and on metric queries that cross a threshold.
Single sign-on is included in the Community Edition and Teams plan, while SAML is limited to Teams and Enterprise.
Eligible startups pay $19 a month for the first 12 months, including $19 of usage.

plans.name: Community Edition (self-hosted)
plans.notes: Open source, you run and pay for the infrastructure

plans.name: Teams
plans.notes: Includes $49 of usage. Traces at $0.30 per GB with 15-day retention, metrics at $0.10 per million samples with 1-month retention

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Starting price. Includes dedicated cloud, bring your own cloud and self-hosted with support

hiddenCosts: Logs are also billed at $0.30 per GB ingested, so a team that sends logs and traces pays for both.
The pricing page shows a free sign-up button but does not state a trial length.
Self-hosting is free to license, though the team pays for servers and upkeep.
